answer_1.quote: We experiment with three LLM families and two constraint-satisfaction tasks -constrained commonsense generation, CommonGen and harmless text generation, HTG (Anthropic HH-RLHF). ...

answer_2.quote: We report % Soft Constraint Satisfaction and % Hard Constraint Satisfaction for CommonGen, and % harmless for HTG, measured by an external LLM classifier.

answer_3.quote: To evaluate the harmless text generation task, we use an external LLM, Llama-Guard-3-8B (Llama, which is especially fine-tuned for content safety classification task).

answer_4.quote: We use Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth for the evaluation, where the annotators are presented with the same prompt as Llama-Guard ... and are instructed to mark the Assistant response as safe or unsafe.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to label each generated response as safe or unsafe based on provided examples.
